title: Ruling: Bari's star threshold against Rye
body: With Chardonnay, Rye usually loses from Bari 5★, some say 4★. Before 10-08 the flip sat at 6–7★.

title: Ruling: 5★ Bari is a floor
body: Under 5★ Soul Guidance covers one charger and the Bari deck loses to Rye.

title: Ruling: 'Rye beats Bari' is mostly Rumble
body: Rumble's +30% DR keeps Rye's tanks alive; in regular Arena the same deck dies in seconds.

title: A set Bari deck
body: 'Set' means about 230% unbuffed crit, so the dive crits through Moon Rabbit.

title: Attacker advantage
body: Many players report defenses losing to equal attackers. Cause untested.

title: Attacker advantage: theories
body: Perks missing on defense, or skills aiming by arena side (a quoted explanation). Neither is tested.

title: Revenge favours the chaser
body: Revenges cost no gems and hide the attack deck, so leaders avoid hitting rivals first.

title: Chargers dive the highest-ATK enemy
body: Oven, Cherry Cola and Bari dash at the top-ATK enemy, almost always Milk.

title: Lose Milk or Bari, lose the fight
body: Passion Pay cuts Milk's HP by 20%, which is why divers target her.

title: Fights end in the opening
body: With Chardonnay, Bari fights often end before Milk's first heal; mirrors run longer.

title: Princess Bari's Soul Guidance
body: Herself plus one charger (two from 5★): DR, lift and push immunity, aura damage.

title: Soul Guidance numbers
body: At 8★: 5.5 s cooldown, 32% DR, aura 127.8% of the guided cookie's ATK.

title: Moon Rabbit's debuff
body: Cuts ATK and crit rate of enemies near her (about −50% / −130% at 9★, datamine).

title: Moon Rabbit misses Rye
body: Back-line Rye isn't hit by Moon Rabbit's debuff.

title: The first cast wins
body: Whoever casts first nearly always wins; CC on a cooldown delays the cast.

title: Skill Haste has diminishing returns
body: Cooldown = base × 100 ÷ (100 + haste).

title: DR stacks multiplicatively
body: 10% from Icy Birdie and 10% from a perk give 19%, not 20%.

title: ATK order routes the buffs
body: Projectile Speed receivers (Chardonnay, Milk) take Pomegranate's beam first; the rest go by ATK rank.

title: ATK order counts every bonus
body: Pet, perk and captain ATK% change the order; check it in battle.

title: Synergy givers buff receivers first
body: Macaron's buff can go to Milky Way instead of along her line.

title: Rye in battle
body: Buffed Rye went from 17.9K to 146K ATK and from 90% to 221% crit.

title: Auto placement goes by range
body: Auto-formation places cookies by attack range; equal ranges go left first.

title: Formation geometry
body: Left to right is back line to front: Macaron (range 7) left, Moon Rabbit (1) right.

title: Opponent cards look mirrored
body: Read slots only from your own formation screen.

title: Stars on cards
body: Yellow stars count to 5; each pink star above that adds one.

title: Decoys and targeting
body: Rye's first volley fires where she faces; an isolated decoy can soak it.

title: Evasion against accuracy
body: About 1,200 evasion beats arena presets; one accuracy line breaks it.

title: Peach's evasion
body: Peach's skill adds 45% evasion; Coffee's accuracy buff or Doughnut King answers her.

title: Merc Lv.4 perks decide mirrors
body: Lv.4 unlocks a second perk; in the Rye mirror the side without perks loses.

title: Healing reduction ended the heal meta
body: Pinot's heal cut beats heal stacks; shields from Ion and Rockstar aren't cut.

title: Partly hidden Arena defenses
body: Defenses hide 1–4 cookies by tier; ranking cards show the placeholders.

title: Displayed power overstates PvP strength
body: Power counts stats PvP ignores; 2× power gaps fall routinely.

title: Arena power after 10-08
body: Displayed power jumped mostly from Chardonnay and crit RES gear, not the level cap.

title: Chardonnay (from 10-08)
body: SSR Grass support: a 1×8 barrier giving crit and push RES along a line, Volley, and 194–250% damage.

title: Chardonnay numbers (datamine)
body: Crit +50→100%, Volley +100→200%, push RES +40→60%, for 5 s every 4 s.

title: Chardonnay numbers (client data)
body: Crit +60→120%, push RES +40→60%, Volley 1→2 by stars; 5 s every 4 s; casts almost at once.

title: Chardonnay scales with Skill AMP
body: Her crit buff grows with Skill AMP; her push RES doesn't.

title: Crit buffs don't stack
body: Chardonnay's and Macaron's crit buffs are one kind: only one applies.

title: Crit past 100%
body: Crit rate past 100% rolls stronger crit tiers; crit RES lowers the tier. Fights show 450–700%.

title: Crit RES or DR
body: Against high enemy crit DR is worth more; against low crit, crit RES.

title: Ruling: one 12-cookie team, not 'turtle vs charge'
body: 8-cookie boards are the standard 12 with hidden slots.

title: Ruling: where 'Rye beats Bari' holds
body: Mid-ladder, at similar or lower power. Not against finished Bari at the top, and less so with Chardonnay.

title: What the charge buff does
body: +30% Charge HP made Oven meta; +30% DR lets Rye decks survive the dive.

title: Season 2 kept the charge core
body: The Charge buff stayed, and Bari + Oven sit on 77 of the top 100 on 10-10.

title: Princess Bari's Soul Guidance
body: Stacks with the Charge HP buff, which is why a 1★ Bari still tops damage.

title: Bari's stars in Rumble
body: Bari decks win at 2–3★ here; posters disagree whether 5★ or 8★ is the floor.

title: ATK order routes the buffs
body: Chardonnay and Milk take the beam by Projectile Speed; Rye decks then need Rye next in ATK.

title: Fire crit DMG pets
body: Bari and Oven are Fire, so Floral Froglet (+28% Fire crit DMG) pays once Chardonnay floods crit.

title: Decoy Oven
body: Enemy chargers chase your top-ATK cookie; an Oven out-ATKing Milk pulls them together.

title: Moon Rabbit and Ion hold the dive
body: Moon Rabbit's ATK-down plus Ion's shields form the wall charge decks can't break.

title: Chargers with haste run in alone
body: Hasted chargers engage before Milk's and Pomegranate's buffs land.

title: crumb.gg grids sort by range
body: Board grids list cookies by attack range, not position: membership, not slots.

title: Formation geometry
body: Own attack panels show the standard 12 in the same layout as Arena's Bari deck.

title: Power doesn't decide rank
body: The top account by power (50.8e9) sat 18th on 10-07; #1 had 43.6e9.

title: Matchmaking follows your points
body: Opponents come from near your points; some leave a 1-cookie defense to drop.

title: Evasion is a wildcard
body: 1,100–1,500 evasion defenses beat stronger teams until an accuracy line shows up.

title: Ladder end is a ticket race
body: The top ranks are decided by mileage spent on extra tickets.
